title: Slow English Reading: Rainbow Fish for Beginners (A1–A2)

header.titleZh: 慢速英語閱讀：初學者彩虹魚（A1–A2）
header.titleEn: Slow English Reading: Rainbow Fish for Beginners (A1–A2)

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast. Today.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。今天。

sentences.en: We will be reading The Rainbow Fish. A long way out in the deep blue sea, there lived.
sentences.tc: 我們將讀《彩虹魚》。在遙遠的深藍色大海中，住著一個人。

sentences.en: A fish. Not just any ordinary fish, but the most beautiful fish in the entire ocean. His scales.
sentences.tc: 一條魚。不只是普通的魚，而是整個海洋中最美麗的魚。他的鱗片。

sentences.en: Were every shade of blue and green and purple with sparkling silver scales among them. The other fish.
sentences.tc: 各種顏色的藍色、綠色和紫色，其中都有閃閃發光的銀色鱗片。另一條魚。

sentences.en: Were amazed at his beauty.
sentences.tc: 驚嘆於他的美貌。

sentences.en: They called him the rainbow fish. Come on, rainbow fish.
sentences.tc: 他們稱他為彩虹魚。來吧，彩虹魚。

sentences.en: They would call. Come and play with us. But the rainbow fish would just glide past, proud.
sentences.tc: 他們會打電話。來和我們一起玩吧。但彩虹魚卻驕傲地滑過。

sentences.en: Silent, letting his scales shimmer. One day, a little blue fish followed.
sentences.tc: 沉默不語，讓他的鱗片閃閃發光。有一天，一條藍色的小魚跟著來了。

sentences.en: He called. Wait for me. Please give me one of your shiny scales.
sentences.tc: 他打電話來。等我。請給我一片閃亮的鱗片。

sentences.en: They are so wonderful. And you have so many.
sentences.tc: 他們太棒了。而你有這麼多。

sentences.en: You want me to give you one of my special scales?
sentences.tc: 你想讓我給你一把我的特殊秤嗎？

sentences.en: Who do you think you are? Cried the rainbow fish. Get away from me. Shocked, the little blue?
sentences.tc: 你以為你是誰？彩虹魚叫道。離我遠點。震驚了，小藍？

sentences.en: Fish swam away.
sentences.tc: 魚遊走了。

sentences.en: He was so upset.
sentences.tc: 他很沮喪。

sentences.en: Then on, no one would have anything to do with Rainbow Fish.
sentences.tc: 從此以後，就沒有人再和彩虹魚有任何關係了。

sentences.en: He swam by. What good were the dazzling shimmering scales with no one to admire them? Now.
sentences.tc: 他遊過去了。那些閃閃發光的鱗片如果沒有人欣賞又有什麼用呢？現在。

sentences.en: He was the lonliest fish in the entire ocean. One day.
sentences.tc: 他是整個海洋中最孤獨的魚。一天。

sentences.en: He poured out all of his troubles to the starfish.
sentences.tc: 他把所有的煩惱都傾訴給了海星。

sentences.en: I really am beautiful. Why doesn't anybody like me?
sentences.tc: 我確實很美麗。為什麼沒有人喜歡我？

sentences.en: I can't answer that for you, said the starfish.
sentences.tc: 「我無法回答你這個問題，」海星說。

sentences.en: If you go beyond the coral reef to a deep cave, you will find the wise octopus. Maybe.
sentences.tc: 如果你越過珊瑚礁進入一個很深的洞穴，你會發現聰明的章魚。或許。

sentences.en: She can help you. The rainbow fish found the cave. It was very dark inside.
sentences.tc: 她可以幫助你。彩虹魚找到了洞穴。裡面很暗。

sentences.en: He couldn't see anything.
sentences.tc: 他什麼也看不見。

sentences.en: Then suddenly two eyes caught him in their glare and the octopus emerged from the darkness.
sentences.tc: 突然，兩隻眼睛注視著他，章魚從黑暗中出現了。
